svg.title: A switch on one support at height six
svg.desc: Panel a: the 66 sites in three layers of 22 as in Figure 2. The 22 sites of the support U1 are coloured by their rows A+22 and B+22; U1 meets every column once. The switch exchanges the owners of sites 37 and 42. Panel b: the two rows near these sites before and after the switch. In row A+22 the incident gaps 4 and 9 exchange order, and in row B+22 the gaps 8 and 3 exchange order, so both palettes are kept.
